messages.subject: R update on the web server
parts:
Will the web server be updated with the newest R version soon? If I'm not mistaken, devtools needs version 3.0, or is there an other way to install the package on the current R version (2.15.3)? I'am in need of shinyIncubator...

Thank You!

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: R update on the web server
parts:
Hi - we're looking into how to safely update the system to R 3.0. The problem is that, if we were to update it now, everyone's apps would break, since the packages installed in R 2.15 won't load in 3.0.

The new version of devtools,1.2, requires R 3.0, but you can install the previous version with the following:

download.file('http://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib/Archive/devtools/devtools_1.1.tar.gz',
  destfile='devtools_1.1.tar.gz')
install.packages('devtools_1.1.tar.gz', type='source', repos=NULL)
unlink('devtools_1.1.tar.gz')

-Winston
